summary: `tail` must expose the tailnet-scoped list endpoints (devices, users, keys, and the rest of the sync resource set) and derive its advertised resource list from the same map.
reason: Every Tailscale list path carries the env-backed {tailnet} template var, which the client resolves per request, but the generator leaves templated paths out of resourceReadPaths. That left tail with zero resources: every invocation failed as an unknown resource, its examples named resources this API does not have, and verify scored resource-path:tail as a critical failure.
validated_outcome: verify resource-path:tail passes; live `tail <resource> --follow=false` exits 0 for all ten resources.
